definitions.core_principle: Field selection = the dasa/bhukti that will run during study and career-settling years, plus the planets connected to it. Read the NEXT 5-10 years of dasas, not just the current one.
definitions.practical_rule: Final decision must combine (1) marks/ability, (2) the student's interest, (3) family affordability. Astrology confirms direction; it does not replace these.
definitions.question_format: Ask a specific question - 'Is branch X suitable?' - not 'What should he study?'. A single dasa (esp. Rahu) maps to too many fields to pick one blindly.
definitions.time_value: Never waste a year: if the desired seat is unlikely this year, join an alternative course rather than waiting idle.

dasa_field_map.note: Typically at PG level, whatever the UG.

dasa_field_map.dasa: Mercury dasa, or next dasa connected to a strong Mercury

dasa_field_map.note: Too broad on its own - narrow using Rahu's star lord and sign lord.

dasa_field_map.condition_example: Ketu in 10th in a Saturn sign / Mars star -> completes PhD (even abroad).

rules.name: Study delay from retrograde bhukti lord
rules.result: Studies slow / delayed until that bhukti ends; resume afterwards.

rules.name: Research inclination
rules.result: Research path later in life; first complete the main degree (e.g. engineering).

rules.name: CA / auditing
rules.condition: Jupiter dasa with Jupiter own sign AND Mercury strong (incl. neecha-bhanga via exalted planet)

rules.name: Rahu in 8th for exams
rules.condition: Rahu in 8th in own star, sign lord (Venus) well placed in 10th
rules.result: Exams succeed; Rahu in 8th lifts rather than blocks.

rules.name: Science & technology / CS
rules.condition: Rahu in a sign whose lord is own-sign (e.g. Rahu in 7th), dasa lord linked to Ketu/Rahu

rules.name: AI vs robotics
rules.condition: Jupiter dasa now; Saturn dasa only after career settles
rules.result: Choose AI (desk-bound, Jupiter-type work) over robotics (field/outer work, Saturn-type). Supporting signs: 6th lord own-sign in 6th with Mercury (creativity) and Ketu (invention).

rules.name: Medical seat
rules.condition: Saturn dasa Mars bhukti during entrance

branches.then: Challenging; seat more likely via management/private quota (costs more)

rules.name: Paid-seat route
rules.condition: dasa/bhukti planets in 6th/8th in Ketu star linked to Sun
rules.result: Merit seat unlikely this year; paid route possible. Recommend an alternative course this year instead of losing a year.

rules.name: Film / animation / graphics
rules.condition: Next dasa Rahu in 11th, in Mars star, in a Saturn sign
rules.result: Animation, graphics, film technology; Saturn link adds mass-audience success.

rules.name: IT specialisations
rules.condition: Venus dasa followed by Sun dasa, Venus in Ketu star
rules.result: IT over civil; cyber security or data analytics; strong overseas prospects.

rules.name: Mechanical cluster
rules.condition: Venus dasa then Sun then Moon

rules.name: Electrical cluster
rules.condition: Rahu in 10th connected with retrograde (even debilitated) Jupiter, Rahu dasa through student years
rules.result: Electrical, electronics or ECE; top institute possible.

rules.name: Law
rules.condition: Venus dasa with Venus in 12th in own star and dispositor Jupiter aspecting

rules.name: Government job indicator
rules.condition: Jupiter, Mars and Venus each alone in kendras

rules.name: Engineering + govt job
rules.condition: lords of 1 and 5 strong; Venus dasa Jupiter bhukti in teens
rules.result: Engineering stream suits; government job likely later.

rules.name: Govt exam timing
rules.condition: dasa/bhukti not supportive until a given date
rules.result: Advise private-sector job meanwhile; don't spend money/time on govt exams before the supportive period.

rules.name: Study abroad
rules.condition: Jupiter dasa, Jupiter in 10th, supportive bhukti starting
rules.result: Foreign study opportunity opens in that bhukti; settles abroad after studies.

engine_output_suggestion.output: For each candidate branch: supportive / neutral / not supportive, with the dasa reasoning and age window. Always append the marks-interest-affordability reminder.
